package answer

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// ApplyAutoReviewInput represents payload from validator.
type ApplyAutoReviewInput struct {
	StudentTaskAnswerID string
	ValidatorName       string
	AutoScore           *float64
	Passed              bool
	Feedback            *string
	RawResult           map[string]any
	CheckedAt           *time.Time
}

// ApplyAutoReview handles incoming auto review.
type ApplyAutoReview struct {
	Answers         repository.StudentTaskAnswerRepository
	AutoReviews     repository.AutoReviewRepository
	ManualReviews   repository.ManualReviewRepository
	LearningActions repository.LearningActionLifecycleRepository
	Publisher       domain.EventPublisher
}

// Handle stores review and updates answer status.
func (uc ApplyAutoReview) Handle(ctx context.Context, in ApplyAutoReviewInput) (*domain.StudentTaskAnswerAutoReview, error) {
	var review *domain.StudentTaskAnswerAutoReview
	if uc.AutoReviews != nil {
		if existing, err := uc.AutoReviews.GetByAnswerID(ctx, in.StudentTaskAnswerID); err == nil && existing != nil {
			review = existing
		} else if err != nil && err != domain.ErrNotFound {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	if uc.ManualReviews != nil {
		if existing, err := uc.ManualReviews.GetByAnswerID(ctx, in.StudentTaskAnswerID); err == nil && existing != nil {
			return nil, nil
		} else if err != nil && err != domain.ErrNotFound {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	answer, err := uc.Answers.GetByID(ctx, in.StudentTaskAnswerID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if answer.Status != domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusUnderReview {
		if answer.Status == domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed || answer.Status == domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusFailed {
			return review, nil
		}
		return nil, domain.ErrInvalidStatus
	}
	if review == nil {
		checkedAt := time.Now().UTC()
		if in.CheckedAt != nil {
			checkedAt = in.CheckedAt.UTC()
		}
		review = &domain.StudentTaskAnswerAutoReview{
			ID:                  uuid.NewString(),
			StudentTaskAnswerID: in.StudentTaskAnswerID,
			CheckedAt:           checkedAt,
			ValidatorName:       in.ValidatorName,
			AutoScore:           in.AutoScore,
			Passed:              in.Passed,
			Feedback:            in.Feedback,
			RawResult:           in.RawResult,
		}
		if err := uc.AutoReviews.Save(ctx, *review); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	if review.Passed {
		answer.Status = domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed
	} else {
		answer.Status = domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusFailed
	}
	answer.UpdatedAt = review.CheckedAt
	if err := closeAnswerLearningAction(ctx, uc.LearningActions, uc.Answers, *answer, review.CheckedAt); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if uc.Publisher != nil {
		_ = uc.Publisher.Publish(domain.SubjectTaskAnswerAutoApplied, map[string]any{
			"student_task_answer_id": in.StudentTaskAnswerID,
			"passed":                 review.Passed,
		})
	}
	return review, nil
}
